_comment: Phase 0 candidate models. license_verified must be true before a compiled model ships in an image. Check the license on the source page and record the date.

ctc.architecture: Citrinet (1D separable conv, squeeze-excitation), CTC, sentencepiece 256
ctc.notes: About 10 MB int8: slightly above the 8 MB parameter cache. Expect off-chip streaming or use 2 segments.

ctc.training_data: LibriSpeech, Mozilla Common Voice, WSJ, Fisher, Switchboard, NSC
ctc.license: to verify on the NGC page
ctc.notes: About 19 MB int8. Parameters stream from host memory on each window; latency depends on USB/PCIe bandwidth. Fisher/Switchboard training includes 8 kHz telephone speech.

ctc.license: to verify on the NGC page
ctc.notes: Only known small German CTC model with a conv-only architecture. Read speech only; expect a high WER on telephone calls.

ctc.source: own fine-tune of en-citrinet-256 on Common Voice German (CC0)
ctc.architecture: Citrinet 256, CTC, new German sentencepiece vocabulary
ctc.training_data: Mozilla Common Voice German (CC0) with telephone augmentation
ctc.notes: Fallback if de-quartznet-15x5 fails the gate. Needs a GPU for training; not part of the tools in this phase.

langid.source: train_langid.py on Common Voice German and English (CC0)
langid.architecture: small 2D CNN on 2 s log-mel, 2 classes
langid.notes: Alternative without a classifier: CTC confidence of both models (--lang-mode confidence, doubles the TPU load).

excluded.reason: Transformer attention, dynamic shapes and size: not compilable for the Edge TPU.
Attention, LayerNorm and GELU map poorly; models are larger than the parameter cache.
LSTM layers run mostly on the CPU after compilation; project is archived.
Not TensorFlow Lite models; no conversion path to the Edge TPU.
License terms of the STT models are not clearly compatible with redistribution under AGPL-3.0; not evaluated.
